title: fix(spec,service-automation,lint)!: registration and validate judge a connector_action's connectorConfig.input value slot
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao8zjUCX5w2bY9jeptPaF4yU)_

Fixes #27968

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：流程里"调用连接器"节点的输入值，现在在注册流程和 `objectstack validate` 时就会被检查，和子流程的输入用同一条规则。
- 为什么改：之前写错的计算表达式、旧的 `{…}` 模板写法能顺利保存和上线，要等流程真正跑到这一步才失败，或者把 `{record.title}` 这样的原文直接发给外部系统。
- 风险与回滚：已经存在、带这三种写法的流程会被拒绝注册（启动时打一条 warn 并跳过该流程，其他流程照常）；仓库内只有示例应用的一处 Slack 文案命中，已改写。回滚只需 revert 本 PR，不涉及数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/automation/flow-node-expression-paths.ts` 新增的 `connector_action` 条目和"兄弟区块"根，以及两个新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/builtin/connector-input-registration.test.ts` 和 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-expressions.connector-input.test.ts`，三种写法都被拒绝，合法表达式照常注册并运行。
- 需要你做的：无。席内契约复审 PASS（评论 6525595405），由席位落地；skills 下的过时说明已立卡 #28162 交 skills 车道。

## What changes

- **The ledger gains a sibling-block root** (`packages/spec/src/automation/flow-node-expression-paths.ts`). A `FlowNodeExpressionPath` may now name `block`, the node property its `path` is rooted in. It defaults to `config`, so every existing entry keeps its meaning. `FLOW_NODE_SIBLING_EXPRESSION_BLOCKS` lists the addressable blocks (today only `connectorConfig` → `connector_action`). `resolveFlowNodeExpressions` and `resolveFlowNodeValueSlots` take the node's sibling blocks as an optional third argument, and each result carries its `block`. The new entry is `connector_action` · `connectorConfig` · `input.*` · `value`.
- **One judge, no second list.** `flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals` (in `flow-value-slot-template.ts`) reads the same entry and reports `block`. A sibling-block slot takes the generic value-slot remedy, without the callee sentence a child flow's input adds. `flow-node-config-refusals.ts` skips block-rooted entries, because its walk addresses only `config`.
- **Both doors pass the node.** In `service-automation`, `flow-registration-checks.ts` locates a refusal at `connectorConfig.input.<key>`. In `lint`, `validate-expressions.ts` does the same, so `objectstack validate` and the runtime authoring gate judge the map too. No service-automation-only judge was added (triage 6487582764).
- **Declared in the schema.** `FlowNodeSchema.connectorConfig.input` values carry `.meta({ xExpression: 'value' })` and stay `z.unknown()`, so `FlowSchema.parse` is unchanged. The describe text now says what a value is.
- **The ratchet reads a third channel.** `getFlowNodeSiblingBlockJsonSchemas()` hands the sibling-block JSON Schema to `config-expression-ledger.test.ts`. A marker on a block the ledger cannot address fails the ratchet.
- **Declared rider.** The stale doc comment in the `FlowSchema` example (formerly `flow.zod.ts:950–951`, "handed to the action as written: no template is read there") now reads "Each `connectorConfig.input` value is a literal, handed to the action as written, or a CEL value envelope evaluated in the run's scope before dispatch".
- **Other changes.**
  - The `engine.ts` `evaluateValueEnvelope` docblock is updated (comment only).
  - The ADR-0087 D3 entry is `18.connector-action-input-value-slot-judged`.
  - There are three changesets, one per package.
  - The regenerated artefacts are `api-surface/automation.json`, `export-origins/automation.json` and `content/docs/references/automation/flow.mdx`.

**File-surface amendments (producer side, named per the order):**
- `examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts`: `TaskCompletedSlackFlow`'s `text: '✅ Task done: {record.title}'` is now `{ dialect: 'cel', source: "'✅ Task done: ' + record.title" }`. The new judge refuses the old spelling. It never interpolated: Slack received the braces as written.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.flow-credential-literal.test.ts` and `packages/cli/test/flow-credential-literal-doors.e2e.test.ts`: the DARK variant's connector input `'{api_token}'` is now a CEL envelope, `{ dialect: 'cel', source: "{'clientSecret': api_token}" }`. Its intent is unchanged: a non-literal credential the advisory does not flag.

## Why

The executor half (#27980) evaluates every top-level CEL envelope in `connectorConfig.input`. The build doors judge value slots only through the ledger, and the ledger could address nothing outside `node.config`. Under `connectorConfig.input`, `registerFlow` and `objectstack validate` accepted three shapes that they refuse under a `subflow`'s `config.input`: a malformed envelope, a template envelope and a `{…}` token. That gave one slot two reject sets, and a malformed envelope was first met by a run. Triage 6516097905 ruled that the ledger gains the sibling block and its consumers read it with no second list.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #28162

## Verification

Final head `6a06a420` (merged with `origin/main` `91a423ef`). The suites and the gate sweep ran on `0a88f925` (`origin/main` `6b125a7a`). After the last merge, the closure was rebuilt and the new test files, the ledger ratchet, `residual-top-level-flow-boot.test.ts` (from #28048), `check:generated` and full dogfood were re-run.

- **Rejection tests.**
  - `service-automation` `connector-input-registration.test.ts` has 6 tests. Its three cells are a malformed CEL envelope (`{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'rec.' }` → `VALUE_ENVELOPE_REFUSAL`), a template envelope (→ `VALUE_ENVELOPE_REFUSAL`) and `'{rec.id}'` (→ `VALUE_SLOT_TEMPLATE_REFUSAL`). Each asserts `node 'call' (connector_action) connector_action input value at connectorConfig.input.customerId: <refusal>`, checks the literal key beside it is not named, and compares against a `subflow` `config.input` control that gives the same refusal. The file also shows that a refused flow cannot run (the handler is never called), that a valid envelope plus literals registers and the run evaluates it, and that a node with no `input` registers.
  - `lint` `validate-expressions.connector-input.test.ts` has 5 tests: the same three shapes at `connectorConfig.input.<key>`, a valid envelope passing, and the runtime authoring gate refusing with rule `expression-invalid`.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to HEAD): every one of the four consumer call sites going back to its two-argument form turns red.
  - registration `resolveFlowNodeExpressions` → 2 envelope cells red;
  - registration `flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals` → token cell and not-registered test red;
  - lint resolve → 2 envelope cells red;
  - lint template → token cell and runtime-gate test red.
- **Suites.**
  - `service-automation`: 226 files / 2865 tests green.
  - `lint`: 179 files / 7649 tests green.
  - `spec`: full suite 756 files / 22516 tests green.
  - `metadata-protocol` credential-literal gate: 3/3.
  - After the merge: `connector-input-schema.test.ts` (from #27995), `connector-openapi` `input-schema-dispatch.test.ts`, the ledger ratchet and both new files are green.
  - `tsc --noEmit` is clean for spec, service-automation and lint.
- **Full dogfood** (owed by the narrowing arm, under the verify lock, closure built): 358 files / 2883 tests green, 20 skipped, on `6a06a420`. An earlier run on `0a88f925` had 1 red (`api-action-door-forward`, the main defect #28082 fixed by #28095), which is why main was merged again.
- **Gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 112 commands, each run `</dev/null` with its exit recorded. `--ran` reconcile: 112 derived, 112 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Three gates first exited 3 (prerequisite): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone; the pinned fixture commit was fetched), `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (unbuilt packages). All three exit 0 after the prerequisite. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: OK. eslint over the changed files (`--no-inline-config`): clean. `check:generated`: all 14 up to date.
- `packages/cli/test/flow-credential-literal-doors.e2e.test.ts` is integration tier and is declared to CI; it was not run locally.

## Acceptance notes

- **In-tree survey of `connectorConfig.input`.** There are 6 authored connector inputs outside tests: 4 in `examples/app-showcase` flows, 1 in `ui/apps/console/src/preview-samples.ts:248` and 1 in `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`. The new judge refuses exactly 1: the showcase `post_to_slack` text, rewritten above. Two test fixtures (the DARK credential variants) were refused and rewritten. The conversion fixture `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts:1381/1425` (`flow-node-connector-config-lift`, `retiredFromLoadPath`) still holds `'Task done: {record.title}'`. It is a before/after transform fixture that is never registered, so it is left as it is.
- **Not narrowed.** `FlowSchema.parse` is unchanged: the map stays `z.unknown()`, as every value slot in an open `config` does. `input` stays optional.
- **Existing rows.** A stored flow carrying one of the three shapes is skipped at boot with the existing `failed to register flow` warn, and the flows beside it still register. ADR-0087 D3 entry `connector-action-input-value-slot-judged` carries the prescription. No D2 conversion exists, because no token has a lossless CEL spelling and a malformed envelope carries no source to correct.
- **Noted, not changed.**
  - `conversions/refused-shapes.ts` detector `flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused` still walks `config` only. Its "listed exactly when the door refuses" property no longer covers a connector token. A follow-up can extend the detector, which reads the same ledger.
  - `ui` `flow-value-envelope.ts` `isValueEnvelopeSlot` ignores `block`. Its one false-positive path, `config.input` on `connector_action`, is refused by the parse already. `ui/` is untouched.
  - `lint` also applies its unbound-root check to connector input envelopes, as it does for every value slot.
- **Contract review** is owed (narrowing) and is run by the triage seat.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint over the changed files passes (the whole-tree `pnpm lint` runs in CI).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
